problemSignature.symptom: Fixture runner wrote reports saying KiCad validation was unavailable even though kicad-cli was installed in a common Windows path.

rootCause: The fixture runner was a state/report writer and did not call the existing KiCad CLI adapter, so generated boards could advance with stale validation language.
fixSummary: Connect fixture generation to detectKiCadCli, runDrc, and runErc. Persist real DRC/ERC JSON reports and manifest counts before routing.

testsAdded: fixture runner creates odd-shape preroute KiCad artifacts without fake manufacturing

recipe: Detect kicad-cli using configured path, environment path, and common Windows KiCad installs.
Run PCB DRC and schematic ERC immediately after writing fixture KiCad files.
Write reports/drc.json and reports/erc.json into the generated project folder.
Update project manifest and final status from measured KiCad evidence.
safetyRules: Do not mark validation as passed without KiCad reports.
Do not export manufacturing files before routing/export stages run.
Keep generated fixture work outside protected ESC/FC paths.
